name: Recycling
highLevelGoals: The User aims to quickly find recycling facilities in their vicinity by searching with a zip code, enabling convenient waste disposal.
The User seeks to view essential details about recycling centers, including operational hours, accepted materials, and location maps, to plan their recycling efforts effectively.
The User desires to be informed about upcoming recycling events and special waste drop-off sites to participate in community recycling initiatives.
The User aims to personalize their experience by saving favorite facilities and managing their account settings for a more tailored interaction with the application.
The User wants to schedule flexible pickup times and receive recommendations for recycling centers based on their weekly schedule and waste types, to optimize their recycling efforts.
The User aims to view maps displaying public recycling bins and special waste drop-off sites in their area, to easily locate alternative disposal options.
The User aims to create and manage their personal account, including registration and password recovery, to access personalized features and secure their information.
The User desires to receive tempting rewards for using the website, incentivizing their participation in recycling efforts.
The Administrator's goal is to maintain up-to-date and accurate information about all recycling facilities on the platform, ensuring users receive reliable data.
The Administrator aims to efficiently process and respond to user feedback, complaints, and questions to continuously improve the service and user satisfaction.
The Administrator seeks to establish and maintain direct communication channels with recycling facilities to update them on new features and address any concerns.
The Facility Representative aims to update their facility's information, including accepted materials and operational hours, to prevent misinformation and improve user experience.
The Facility Representative seeks a direct channel to communicate any operational issues or concerns to the site administrators for prompt resolution.
The Superuser aims to update recycling center information with the most current details, ensuring users always have access to accurate data.
The Superuser's goal is to answer user questions about recycling centers efficiently and accurately, enhancing user satisfaction and trust.
The Recycling Facility aims to ensure its information, including accepted materials and operating hours, is accurately reflected on the platform to avoid user confusion.
The Recycling Facility seeks to effectively convey any operational changes, issues, or concerns to the site administrators for timely resolution and platform updates.
The Developer aims to create and enhance the website's functionalities, including UI/UX, to provide a robust and user-friendly application.
lowLevelGoals: The User will input a zip code into a search field and initiate a search to find recycling facilities in that area.
The User will select specific material types (e.g., plastic, paper, glass) from a dropdown or checkbox list to refine the search results for recycling facilities.
The User will select a minimum eco-friendliness rating from a filter option to refine the search results for recycling facilities.
The User will see a list of recycling facilities displayed on the screen after submitting a zip code, showing their names and basic location information.
The User will interact with an item in the list of recycling facilities to navigate to a dedicated page or section displaying comprehensive information about that facility.
The User will see the opening and closing times for each day of the week for a specific recycling facility.
The User will see a clear list or categorization of materials that a specific recycling facility accepts for disposal.
The User will click on the address of a recycling facility, which will launch an external mapping application (e.g., Google Maps) displaying the facility's location and providing navigation options.
The User will opt-in to receive alerts about new recycling events by clicking a 'subscribe' button or checking a preference box.
The User will get an alert on their device or within the application when a new recycling event is announced that matches their subscribed preferences.
The User will access a dedicated section of the application that displays information about temporary locations for special waste disposal.
The User will click a 'favorite' or 'star' icon associated with a recycling facility to save it for quick access later.
The User will click the 'favorite' or 'star' icon again on a previously favorited facility to unfavorite it.
The User will navigate to their account profile and modify personal information or security credentials.
The User will select their preferred method of receiving notifications from a list of options in their account settings.
The User will choose a specific date and time slot from an available calendar or schedule interface for a recycling pickup.
The User will provide their availability or preferred days/times for recycling activities, allowing the system to suggest suitable facilities.
The User will select or list the materials they plan to recycle, enabling the system to recommend facilities that accept those specific waste types.
The User will access an interactive map that highlights the locations of public recycling bins, distinct from full facilities.
The User will access an interactive map that highlights the locations of temporary or specialized waste drop-off sites.
The User will fill out a registration form with information such as email, password, and possibly name, then submit it to create an account.
The User will click a 'Forgot Password' link and follow the prompts, typically by entering their email address to receive a reset link.
The User will enter their registered email and password into the login form and submit it to gain access to their personalized features.
The User will navigate to a help section or documentation page to understand how to use various features of the application.
The User will receive a specific number of points or a badge in their account after successfully logging a recycling activity (e.g., scheduling a pickup, visiting a facility).
The User will access a dedicated section of their profile or dashboard to see their accumulated reward points.
The User will select an available reward from a catalog and use their accumulated points to claim it.
The Administrator will input all necessary details (name, address, hours, accepted materials) into a form to register a new recycling facility.
The Administrator will select an existing facility and modify its details (e.g., update operational hours, add new accepted materials) through an editing interface.
The Administrator will select a facility and confirm its removal from the system, making it no longer visible to users.
The Administrator will access a dashboard or list displaying all user feedback, complaints, and questions.
The Administrator will open a specific feedback item and compose a reply to the user, which can be sent via email or an in-app message.
The Administrator will change the status of a feedback item to 'resolved' after addressing the user's concern or question.
The Administrator will select a specific facility and compose a message to its designated representative through an internal messaging system.
The Administrator will create a broadcast message or announcement that is distributed to all registered recycling facilities on the platform.
The Facility Representative will log into their facility's profile and modify the list of materials their facility accepts for recycling.
The Facility Representative will log into their facility's profile and adjust the opening and closing times for their facility.
The Facility Representative will use a dedicated form or messaging system to report a problem or concern to the administrators.
The Facility Representative will access a dashboard or list to see the current status (e.g., 'pending', 'in progress', 'resolved') of issues they have reported.
The Superuser will access the facility management interface and update the list of materials a specific recycling center accepts.
The Superuser will access the facility management interface and modify the opening and closing times for a specific recycling center.
The Superuser will use a dedicated form to input all details for a new recycling center, making it available to users.
The Superuser will navigate to a section of the platform that displays all unanswered user inquiries.
The Superuser will select a user question, type their response, and submit it, which will be delivered to the user.
The Superuser will change the status of a user inquiry to 'answered' after providing a response.
The Recycling Facility will provide an updated list of accepted materials to the administrators for publication on the platform.
The Recycling Facility will provide updated operational hours to the administrators for publication on the platform.
The Recycling Facility will send a message or submit a form detailing an operational issue or concern to the site administrators.
The Recycling Facility will inform site administrators about any changes in its operational status, such as temporary closures or special hours.
The Developer will write and integrate code for an improved search algorithm to enhance the accuracy and speed of locating recycling facilities based on user input.
The Developer will create wireframes, mockups, and then implement the front-end code for a new, more intuitive display of recycling facility information.
The Developer will write code to connect the application with an external mapping service (e.g., Google Maps API) to display facility locations and provide navigation.
